# Miauterm v0.1.0

## Included

- Debian 13 (Trixie) ARM64 root filesystem launched through PRoot.
- First-run root filesystem extraction with progress reporting.
- Terminal sessions, themes, extra keys, and custom font selection based on the Cortex Terminal codebase.
- Debian backup, restore, reset, failsafe access, file manager, and PRoot diagnostics.
- Optional Download and Documents mounts, gated by Android permission.
- Miauterm app commands, including `keysreload` and `reloadfont`.

Requires Android 7.0 or newer on an `arm64-v8a` device. Release APKs and checksums will be attached by the release workflow when this version is published.
